NODES_DISABLED: Right now, all musical notes are unavailable. Perhaps the reason for this is published on the [official discord server of the bot](https://discord.gg/ffsmJTwfnq).
QUEUE_EMPTY: The queue is empty. Playback has stopped.
NOTHING_PLAYING: Nothing is playing right now. The function cannot be used.
CANT_JOIN_VOICE: I can't join into this voice channel.
NEED_TO_BE_IN_SAME: You must be in the same voice channel with the bot to use this feature.
NEED_TO_BE_IN_VC: You must be in the voice channel to use this feature.
PLAYING_STOPPED: All tracks have been successfully stopped playing.
HELP_TITLE: List of all available Cordy commands
HELP_DESC:
{0} — This command. A list of all the commands of the bot.
{1} — Basic information about the Cordy project.

{2} — Track search and playback.
{3} — Skip the playing track.
{4} — Stop playback of tracks completely.
{5} — Loop the playback of a single song or an entire queue.
{6} — Getting a list of tracks in the queue.
